category_title: Reluctant readers who achieve cognitive flow on digital devices but struggle with print focus
scenario_title: Struggling to maintain focus with traditional paper books during SSR
minimal_context: The student is participating in a 50-minute Friday Silent Sustained Reading session in the classroom using a traditional paper book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our 50-minute Friday Silent Sustained Reading session. Please open your traditional paper book and begin reading your free choice novel.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I stay more focused when I'm on the Nook.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are using the paper books right now. Please look at your book and read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah. I don't know. I just can't focus, can't read.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to keep trying for the rest of the period.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I lose focus just randomly. I don't like this because I'm not doing anything but sitting.
